article.title: ‘God help us authors’: Helm’s defense of Rooney ignites Downing Street Row

article.content: Police are assessing Sarah Helm’s Palestine Action post as hundreds of writers condemn restrictions forcing Sally Rooney from Britain’s market. The post ‘God help us authors’: Helm’s defense of Rooney ignites Downing Street Row appeared first on MR Online .
